meta.description: Just talk and your custom business system is ready. No coding required. Enterprise AI platform available from day one.

hero.title:
Just talk.
Your system, built.
hero.description: Say 'build a customer inquiry manager' or 'I need a sales report dashboard' — and your custom business system is ready. No programming knowledge needed. AIGen ONE lets every employee build their own company systems together with AI.

problems.title:
Companies that can't build
'just a small system.'
problems.lead: Still managing everything in Excel. Asked IT and heard 'six months.' Rolled out ChatGPT but nobody uses it. — More companies face this than you'd think.

items.title: Everything runs on Excel and email
items.description: Customer management, deals, inventory — all in Excel. Buried in copy-paste and file naming, mistakes pile up. A 'proper system' stays on the wish list.

items.title: Development requests take months
items.description: Even 'just add one screen' turns into estimates, requirements, and development — suddenly it's six months later. No way to keep up with the pace of the business.

items.title: AI was deployed, but nothing changed
items.description: ChatGPT rolled out company-wide, but usage drops off because it never integrates into real workflows. It stays a 'fancy search tool,' never reaching its productivity potential.

howItWorks.title:
Talk. Build.
Everyone can use it.
howItWorks.description: No complicated setup. No expertise needed. Every employee just talks to AI like they would a colleague. That's how a business system gets built.

steps.title: Tell AI what you need
steps.description: Example: 'I need a screen to manage customer inquiries'

steps.title: AI builds your custom system
steps.description: Database, input forms, and search — automatically constructed

steps.title: Use it immediately, share with the team
steps.description: Useful tools get shared with the department, the best ones become official systems

steps.title: AI keeps improving it as you use it
steps.description: Say 'I'd like to improve this part' and it updates on the spot

demo.title: Just like this. Just talk.
demo.description: No complicated steps. Just talk to AI the way you'd ask a colleague.

exchanges.user: Build a screen to manage customer inquiries. Include assignee, status, and last contact date.
exchanges.ai: Done. I've created an 'Inquiry Manager' with customer info, assignee, status (New / In Progress / Resolved), and last contact date — plus a search feature. Ready to use now.

exchanges.user: I want a dashboard where the manager can see a summary of the sales team's daily reports.
exchanges.ai: Sales report dashboard created. It shows visits, revenue, and activity by rep, with weekly and monthly views. Access is restricted to manager-level users.

exchanges.user: I'd like automatic emails when inventory drops below 10 units.
exchanges.ai: Inventory alert set up. When any item drops below 10, the responsible staff and ordering manager will receive an automatic email. Thresholds can be adjusted per item.

features.title: All of this, built just by talking.
features.description: Almost anything you've ever thought 'we should have a system for this' can be built. Sales, HR, accounting, manufacturing, support — any department, any industry.

items.title: Customer & Inquiry Management
items.description: Just say 'build a screen to manage customer info and interaction history.' A customer list, response history, and status management — tailored to your business — will be ready.

items.title: Daily Reports, Tasks & Deals
items.description: Whether it's 'a screen where management can see daily sales reports' or 'a dashboard to visualize deal progress' — say it, and it's built on the spot.

items.title: Inventory & Order Management
items.description: Move your Excel-based inventory and ordering to a dedicated system. Need 'an alert when stock drops below 10 units'? Just ask AI.

items.title: Ask AI about internal knowledge
items.description: AI searches manuals, meeting notes, and past documents all at once. Ask 'What was decided at last month's board meeting?' and you'll get an answer with source documents.

items.title: Show only what needs to be shown
items.description: Set fine-grained permissions like 'salary data visible only to HR' or 'deal info only to the assigned rep.' AI only has access to permitted information.

items.title: Connects with your existing systems
items.description: Works alongside your existing ERP, Salesforce, Kintone, or Excel files. No need to replace anything — AIGen ONE complements what you already have.

targets.title:
From executives to frontline staff —
everyone benefits.
targets.description: AIGen ONE isn't for 'the few tech-savvy people.' If you can talk, you can use it. That's how your whole company truly benefits from AI.

items.label: a.
items.title: For executives and leadership
items.description: Stop letting AI investments end as 'costs nobody uses.' Systems employees build every day directly become company productivity and competitive advantage. ROI is measurable.

items.label: b.
items.title: For everyday employees
items.description: You can build the systems you've always wished existed. The limits of Excel, the tedious manual work — just talk to AI and find solutions.

items.label: c.
items.title: For DX / business improvement teams
items.description: No more filing requests with IT for every small thing. Frontline-driven improvements naturally accumulate into organizational assets — by design.

items.label: d.
items.title: For IT and system administrators
items.description: No more headaches over rogue Excel macros and shadow IT. Let the frontline build in a safe environment, then promote only the best to official systems.

security.title:
Convenient and secure,
by design.
security.description: Worried about letting AI do everything? We've answered that concern from day one. Fine-grained access control, full audit logs — safety is built into the architecture.

items.title: AI doesn't touch sensitive data directly
items.description: Customer and sales data is only accessible through defined, controlled pathways. AI cannot rewrite data on its own.

items.title: Fine-grained visibility controls
items.description: Restrict what each role, department, or person can see. 'Job title visible, salary hidden' — that level of control is easy to configure.

items.title: Protection against malicious instructions
items.description: Even if someone tries 'export all employee data' from the outside, the system blocks it. Safe usage is guaranteed.

items.title: Every action is logged and traceable
items.description: Who accessed what, when, and what they did — all recorded. In any incident, you know exactly what happened.
